Multi English · 5th Grade · Theme 3

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Oklarla testler arasında geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece is pointing to a model in science class. This organ is inside the head. It helps us think, learn and remember things. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) brain

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece is pointing to a model in science class. This organ is inside the head. It helps us think, learn and remember things.” Bu tarif “brain” kelimesine uyar; brain = beyin. Diğer şıklar: heart (kalp), chin (çene), shoulder (omuz).

2

Mert is running in the school garden. An organ in his chest is beating faster. It pumps blood around his body. This organ is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) heart

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert is running in the school garden. An organ in his chest is beating faster. It pumps blood around his body.” Bu tarif “heart” kelimesine uyar; heart = kalp. Diğer şıklar: brain (beyin), tongue (dil), skin (deri, ten).

3

The teacher is showing a picture of the human body. Red liquid is moving through the vessels in the picture. This liquid carries oxygen around the body. It is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) blood

Paragraftaki ipucu: “The teacher is showing a picture of the human body. Red liquid is moving through the vessels in the picture. This liquid carries oxygen around the body.” Bu tarif “blood” kelimesine uyar; blood = kan. Diğer şıklar: hair (saç), bone (kemik), skin (deri, ten).

4

Selin is looking at a model of a skeleton. Its hard parts support the body and protect organs. She is holding one of these hard parts. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) bone

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin is looking at a model of a skeleton. Its hard parts support the body and protect organs. She is holding one of these hard parts.” Bu tarif “bone” kelimesine uyar; bone = kemik. Diğer şıklar: eyelash (kirpik), eyebrow (kaş), tongue (dil).

5

Bora is drawing his sister's face. He draws a line of hair above each eye. This line is not on the edge of the eyelid. Each one is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) eyebrow

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora is drawing his sister's face. He draws a line of hair above each eye. This line is not on the edge of the eyelid.” Bu tarif “eyebrow” kelimesine uyar; eyebrow = kaş. Diğer şıklar: ear (kulak), eye (göz), eyelash (kirpik).

6

Ada is looking closely at her eye in a mirror. She sees small hairs along the edge of her eyelid. Each small hair is an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) eyelash

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ada is looking closely at her eye in a mirror. She sees small hairs along the edge of her eyelid.” Bu tarif “eyelash” kelimesine uyar; eyelash = kirpik. Diğer şıklar: eyebrow (kaş), chin (çene), ear (kulak).

7

Eren is drawing a face in art class. He draws the lower part below the mouth. This part is between the mouth and the neck. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) chin

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren is drawing a face in art class. He draws the lower part below the mouth. This part is between the mouth and the neck.” Bu tarif “chin” kelimesine uyar; chin = çene. Diğer şıklar: eyebrow (kaş), neck (boyun), nose (burun).

8

Duru is holding her bag with one strap. The strap rests where her arm meets her body. She is touching that part with her other hand. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) shoulder

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru is holding her bag with one strap. The strap rests where her arm meets her body. She is touching that part with her other hand.” Bu tarif “shoulder” kelimesine uyar; shoulder = omuz. Diğer şıklar: knee (diz), chin (çene), toe (ayak parmağı).

9

Can is tasting a small piece of fruit. There is a soft organ inside his mouth. It helps him taste the fruit. It is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) tongue

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can is tasting a small piece of fruit. There is a soft organ inside his mouth. It helps him taste the fruit.” Bu tarif “tongue” kelimesine uyar; tongue = dil. Diğer şıklar: neck (boyun), ear (kulak), tooth (diş).

10

Nehir is reading about the human body. One organ covers the outside of the whole body. It protects the parts inside. This organ is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) skin

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir is reading about the human body. One organ covers the outside of the whole body. It protects the parts inside.” Bu tarif “skin” kelimesine uyar; skin = deri, ten. Diğer şıklar: tongue (dil), brain (beyin), heart (kalp).

11

Emir's father has hair between his nose and upper lip. He does not have hair on his chin. Emir is drawing this feature in his portrait. His father has a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) moustache

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir's father has hair between his nose and upper lip. He does not have hair on his chin. Emir is drawing this feature in his portrait.” Bu tarif “moustache” kelimesine uyar; moustache = bıyık. Diğer şıklar: beard (sakal), eyebrow (kaş), chin (çene).

12

Sena's uncle has hair on his chin and along his jaw. He is brushing it in front of a mirror. This hair is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) beard

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena's uncle has hair on his chin and along his jaw. He is brushing it in front of a mirror.” Bu tarif “beard” kelimesine uyar; beard = sakal. Diğer şıklar: moustache (bıyık), tongue (dil), eyelash (kirpik).

13

Baran is putting on his socks. He sees five small parts at the end of each foot. Each one is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) toe

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran is putting on his socks. He sees five small parts at the end of each foot.” Bu tarif “toe” kelimesine uyar; toe = ayak parmağı. Diğer şıklar: finger (el parmağı), knee (diz), hand (el).

14

İpek has light yellow hair. Her friend is drawing her portrait and choosing a yellow pencil. İpek is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) blonde

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek has light yellow hair. Her friend is drawing her portrait and choosing a yellow pencil.” Bu tarif “blonde” kelimesine uyar; blonde = sarışın. Diğer şıklar: strong (güçlü), short (kısa), brunette (kumral, esmer).

15

Tolga's hair forms lots of small, tight rings. He is brushing it before school. His hair is naturally ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) curly

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga's hair forms lots of small, tight rings. He is brushing it before school.” Bu tarif “curly” kelimesine uyar; curly = kıvırcık. Diğer şıklar: wavy (dalgalı), short (kısa), straight (düz).

16

Eylül has long hair without any curls or waves. It falls in a smooth line over her shoulders. She is tying her ______ hair back.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) straight

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül has long hair without any curls or waves. It falls in a smooth line over her shoulders.” Bu tarif “straight” kelimesine uyar; straight = düz. Diğer şıklar: short (kısa), wavy (dalgalı), curly (kıvırcık).

17

Ozan's hair has soft, gentle waves. It is not straight and does not form tight curls. He is showing his new hairstyle to a friend. His hair is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) wavy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan's hair has soft, gentle waves. It is not straight and does not form tight curls. He is showing his new hairstyle to a friend.” Bu tarif “wavy” kelimesine uyar; wavy = dalgalı. Diğer şıklar: short (kısa), curly (kıvırcık), straight (düz).

18

Cemre has very powerful arms. She is lifting a heavy box without difficulty. The others need help with the same box. Cemre is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) strong

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre has very powerful arms. She is lifting a heavy box without difficulty. The others need help with the same box.” Bu tarif “strong” kelimesine uyar; strong = güçlü. Diğer şıklar: weak (güçsüz), shy (utangaç), quiet (sessiz).

19

Yusuf is checking his body measurements. He is standing beside a scale on the wall. The top of his head reaches 1.45 metres. He is measuring his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) height

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf is checking his body measurements. He is standing beside a scale on the wall. The top of his head reaches 1.45 metres.” Bu tarif “height” kelimesine uyar; height = boy. Diğer şıklar: age (yaş), population (nüfus), weight (kilo, ağırlık).

20

Melis is standing on a weighing scale. The screen shows 38 kilogrammes. She is checking her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) weight

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis is standing on a weighing scale. The screen shows 38 kilogrammes.” Bu tarif “weight” kelimesine uyar; weight = kilo, ağırlık. Diğer şıklar: population (nüfus), age (yaş), height (boy).

21

Arda tries difficult activities without much fear. Today, he is joining a school climbing activity. He feels nervous, but he does not give up. His friends call him ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) brave

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda tries difficult activities without much fear. Today, he is joining a school climbing activity. He feels nervous, but he does not give up.” Bu tarif “brave” kelimesine uyar; brave = cesur. Diğer şıklar: shy (utangaç), lazy (tembel), rude (kaba).

22

Elif always checks her work before giving it to the teacher. She pays attention to small details. She is checking every answer again now. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) careful

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif always checks her work before giving it to the teacher. She pays attention to small details. She is checking every answer again now.” Bu tarif “careful” kelimesine uyar; careful = dikkatli. Diğer şıklar: noisy (gürültücü), lazy (tembel), naughty (yaramaz).

23

Kerem invents new games and unusual stories. He enjoys making things that nobody else thinks of. He is designing a new board game now. He is very ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) creative

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem invents new games and unusual stories. He enjoys making things that nobody else thinks of. He is designing a new board game now.” Bu tarif “creative” kelimesine uyar; creative = yaratıcı. Diğer şıklar: quiet (sessiz), rude (kaba), worried (endişeli).

24

Buse studies every evening and completes all her tasks. She does not avoid difficult homework. She is working on an extra project today. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) hardworking

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse studies every evening and completes all her tasks. She does not avoid difficult homework. She is working on an extra project today.” Bu tarif “hardworking” kelimesine uyar; hardworking = çalışkan. Diğer şıklar: naughty (yaramaz), lazy (tembel), noisy (gürültücü).

25

Deniz helps classmates when they have problems. He is showing a new student around the school now. He is also carrying the student's books. Deniz is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) helpful

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz helps classmates when they have problems. He is showing a new student around the school now. He is also carrying the student's books.” Bu tarif “helpful” kelimesine uyar; helpful = yardımsever. Diğer şıklar: serious (ciddi), lazy (tembel), rude (kaba).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ceren smiles at new students and talks to them kindly. She enjoys making new friends. She is welcoming a new classmate now. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) friendly

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ceren smiles at new students and talks to them kindly. She enjoys making new friends. She is welcoming a new classmate now.” Bu tarif “friendly” kelimesine uyar; friendly = arkadaş canlısı. Diğer şıklar: shy (utangaç), rude (kaba), serious (ciddi).

2

Ali often tells jokes that make people laugh. His classmates enjoy his stories. He is telling a silly story at break time now. He is very ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) funny

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali often tells jokes that make people laugh. His classmates enjoy his stories. He is telling a silly story at break time now.” Bu tarif “funny” kelimesine uyar; funny = komik. Diğer şıklar: quiet (sessiz), worried (endişeli), serious (ciddi).

3

Pelin does not like doing homework or helping at home. She always looks for an excuse to avoid work. She is lying on the sofa instead of doing her tasks now. She is being ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) lazy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin does not like doing homework or helping at home. She always looks for an excuse to avoid work. She is lying on the sofa instead of doing her tasks now.” Bu tarif “lazy” kelimesine uyar; lazy = tembel. Diğer şıklar: careful (dikkatli), helpful (yardımsever), hardworking (çalışkan).

4

Efe and his friends are shouting in the corridor. They are making a lot of sound. Their teacher asks them to speak softly. They are very ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) noisy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe and his friends are shouting in the corridor. They are making a lot of sound. Their teacher asks them to speak softly.” Bu tarif “noisy” kelimesine uyar; noisy = gürültücü. Diğer şıklar: shy (utangaç), quiet (sessiz), tidy (düzenli).

5

Derya never makes much sound in class. She speaks softly when she answers a question. She is reading silently at her desk now. She is usually ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) quiet

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya never makes much sound in class. She speaks softly when she answers a question. She is reading silently at her desk now.” Bu tarif “quiet” kelimesine uyar; quiet = sessiz. Diğer şıklar: noisy (gürültücü), rude (kaba), funny (komik).

6

Mina often interrupts people and speaks unkindly. She does not say please or thank you. She is shouting at a classmate now. Her behaviour is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) rude

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina often interrupts people and speaks unkindly. She does not say please or thank you. She is shouting at a classmate now.” Bu tarif “rude” kelimesine uyar; rude = kaba. Diğer şıklar: friendly (arkadaş canlısı), helpful (yardımsever), polite (kibar).

7

Berk listens carefully during important discussions. He does not joke when the topic is important. He is talking about a school problem now. He looks very ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) serious

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk listens carefully during important discussions. He does not joke when the topic is important. He is talking about a school problem now.” Bu tarif “serious” kelimesine uyar; serious = ciddi. Diğer şıklar: funny (komik), noisy (gürültücü), naughty (yaramaz).

8

İdil finds it difficult to speak to people she does not know. She usually stays behind her friends in a new group. She is looking down instead of introducing herself now. She is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) shy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil finds it difficult to speak to people she does not know. She usually stays behind her friends in a new group. She is looking down instead of introducing herself now.” Bu tarif “shy” kelimesine uyar; shy = utangaç. Diğer şıklar: brave (cesur), noisy (gürültücü), friendly (arkadaş canlısı).

9

Onur puts his books on shelves and keeps his desk clean. He never leaves clothes on the floor. He is arranging his pencils neatly now. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) tidy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur puts his books on shelves and keeps his desk clean. He never leaves clothes on the floor. He is arranging his pencils neatly now.” Bu tarif “tidy” kelimesine uyar; tidy = düzenli. Diğer şıklar: lazy (tembel), noisy (gürültücü), rude (kaba).

10

Zeynep cannot find her little brother in the crowded shop. She is looking around and asking her mother for help. She thinks something is wrong and feels ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) worried

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep cannot find her little brother in the crowded shop. She is looking around and asking her mother for help.” Bu tarif “worried” kelimesine uyar; worried = endişeli. Diğer şıklar: cool (havalı), funny (komik), happy (mutlu).

11

Aras is riding his bicycle. He always protects his head when he cycles. He is wearing a hard protective covering on his head now. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) helmet

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras is riding his bicycle. He always protects his head when he cycles. He is wearing a hard protective covering on his head now.” Bu tarif “helmet” kelimesine uyar; helmet = kask. Diğer şıklar: hat (şapka), headscarf (başörtüsü), cap (kep).

12

Sıla likes comfortable tops with a hood. Today, she is pulling the hood over her head because of the wind. She is wearing a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) hoodie

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla likes comfortable tops with a hood. Today, she is pulling the hood over her head because of the wind.” Bu tarif “hoodie” kelimesine uyar; hoodie = kapüşonlu sweatshirt. Diğer şıklar: blouse (bluz), shirt (gömlek), skirt (etek).

13

Gökçe has a gold accessory around her wrist. She is showing it to her sister. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) bracelet

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe has a gold accessory around her wrist. She is showing it to her sister.” Bu tarif “bracelet” kelimesine uyar; bracelet = bilezik. Diğer şıklar: earring (küpe), ring (yüzük), necklace (kolye).

14

Emre is walking by the swimming pool. His light sandals have a strap between his big toe and the next toe. He is wearing ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) flip-flops

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emre is walking by the swimming pool. His light sandals have a strap between his big toe and the next toe.” Bu tarif “flip-flops” kelimesine uyar; flip-flops = parmak arası terlik. Diğer şıklar: flats (babet), trainers (spor ayakkabı), boots (bot, çizme).

15

Nisa wears the same special clothes as all the other students at her school. The clothes have the school badge on them. She is putting on her school ______ now.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) uniform

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nisa wears the same special clothes as all the other students at her school. The clothes have the school badge on them.” Bu tarif “uniform” kelimesine uyar; uniform = üniforma. Diğer şıklar: helmet (kask), handbag (el çantası), jewellery (takı).

16

Kaan is getting ready for a formal event. He is placing a long narrow piece of fabric around the collar of his shirt. He is tying it in a knot. He is wearing a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) tie

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kaan is getting ready for a formal event. He is placing a long narrow piece of fabric around the collar of his shirt. He is tying it in a knot.” Bu tarif “tie” kelimesine uyar; tie = kravat. Diğer şıklar: scarf (atkı), necklace (kolye), belt (kemer).

17

Ayşe is wearing blue trousers made from denim. They have pockets and metal buttons. She usually wears these casual trousers at weekends. They are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) jeans

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ayşe is wearing blue trousers made from denim. They have pockets and metal buttons. She usually wears these casual trousers at weekends.” Bu tarif “jeans” kelimesine uyar; jeans = kot pantolon. Diğer şıklar: skirts (etekler), leggings (tayt), shorts (şort).

18

Burak is going outside on a rainy day. He is wearing a special coat that keeps water off his clothes. He chooses his yellow ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) raincoat

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak is going outside on a rainy day. He is wearing a special coat that keeps water off his clothes.” Bu tarif “raincoat” kelimesine uyar; raincoat = yağmurluk. Diğer şıklar: hoodie (kapüşonlu sweatshirt), blouse (bluz), jumper (kazak).

19

Eda is trying to read the board. The letters look unclear without special lenses. She is putting on her ______ to see them better.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) glasses

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda is trying to read the board. The letters look unclear without special lenses.” Bu tarif “glasses” kelimesine uyar; glasses = gözlük. Diğer şıklar: gloves (eldiven), earrings (küpeler), sunglasses (güneş gözlüğü).

20

Tuna is standing in bright sunshine. He protects his eyes with dark lenses. He is wearing ______ at the beach.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) sunglasses

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna is standing in bright sunshine. He protects his eyes with dark lenses.” Bu tarif “sunglasses” kelimesine uyar; sunglasses = güneş gözlüğü. Diğer şıklar: gloves (eldiven), glasses (gözlük), socks (çorap).

21

Cem is choosing trousers in a shop. He does not know whether they fit. He is going into a changing room to ______ the trousers.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) try on

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem is choosing trousers in a shop. He does not know whether they fit.” Bu tarif “try on” kelimesine uyar; try on = kıyafet denemek. Diğer şıklar: carry (taşımak), study (ders çalışmak), touch (dokunmak).

22

Defne has a heavy box in her hands. She is taking it from the classroom to the library. She needs help to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) carry

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne has a heavy box in her hands. She is taking it from the classroom to the library.” Bu tarif “carry” kelimesine uyar; carry = taşımak. Diğer şıklar: study (ders çalışmak), grow (büyümek), wear (giymek).

23

The science teacher asks the class to feel the surface of a model. Aylin is placing her fingers on it. She uses her fingers to ______ the model.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) touch

Paragraftaki ipucu: “The science teacher asks the class to feel the surface of a model. Aylin is placing her fingers on it.” Bu tarif “touch” kelimesine uyar; touch = dokunmak. Diğer şıklar: study (ders çalışmak), wear (giymek), carry (taşımak).

24

Eren is sitting at his desk with a notebook. He is reading his lesson and doing exercises. He usually does this after dinner. He likes to ______ in a quiet room.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) study

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren is sitting at his desk with a notebook. He is reading his lesson and doing exercises. He usually does this after dinner.” Bu tarif “study” kelimesine uyar; study = ders çalışmak. Diğer şıklar: carry (taşımak), grow (büyümek), wear (giymek).

25

Nehir and her friends are in a café. They often get together here after school to talk. She likes to ______ in her free time.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) meet friends

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir and her friends are in a café. They often get together here after school to talk.” Bu tarif “meet friends” kelimesine uyar; meet friends = arkadaşlarla buluşmak. Diğer şıklar: watch matches (maç izlemek), look at (bakmak), try on (kıyafet denemek).

Her soru 4 puan. Yanlış ya da boş bir soruya tıkla; o soruya gidip doğrusunu ve Türkçe çözümünü gör.

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

brain

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) beyin

“brain” kelimesinin Türkçe anlamı “beyin” olur. Bu kelime “Vücut bölümleri ve organlar” grubundandır. Örnek: We think with our brain.

2

heart

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) kalp

“heart” kelimesinin Türkçe anlamı “kalp” olur. Bu kelime “Vücut bölümleri ve organlar” grubundandır. Örnek: My heart beats fast when I run.

3

blood

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) kan

“blood” kelimesinin Türkçe anlamı “kan” olur. Bu kelime “Vücut bölümleri ve organlar” grubundandır. Örnek: Blood carries oxygen around the body.

4

bone

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) kemik

“bone” kelimesinin Türkçe anlamı “kemik” olur. Bu kelime “Vücut bölümleri ve organlar” grubundandır. Örnek: Our bones are hard.

5
